ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I chose Dunlin because the query is a straightforward technical comparison with no sensitive content, so the models' shared flat preference for harm-adjacent material was irrelevant. That left capability as the deciding factor, and Dunlin scores higher across all relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA 64.1 vs 54.3, Extraction & Retrieval 85.3 vs 81.6), making it more likely to give an accurate answer.
